'''Mata Fhernan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and mother to [[Bant'ena Fhernan|Bant'ena]], [[Chai Fhernan|Chai]], and [[Ilim Fhernan]]. Mata was rescued by [[Taria Damsin]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] from an [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], who was hired by [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] to watch Mata and [[Death/Legends|kill]] her if Bant'ena refused to make a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] for him.
